svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Arduino Nano 33 IoT + SpectraFlex™ Voltage Divider
Annotated Hardware Wiring, 12-Bit ADC Calibration & USB Serial Streaming Guide (Default: kFlexConnectedToGnd = true)
SpectraFlex pins are non-polarized. Keep the active sensing strip free of sharp kinks (> 8 mm bend radius).
If you swap the 10 kΩ resistor and sensor positions (resistor to GND, sensor to 3V3), set kFlexConnectedToGnd = false in src/main.cpp.

g.text: Never use 5V / VUSB: Nano 33 IoT pins are strictly 3.3V.
Avoid A4 & A5: Internal I²C pull-ups distort ADC readings.
Check flat baseline: At 10 kΩ flat, V_mid ≈ 1.65 V (~2048).

text.tspan: pio run -t upload && pio device monitor
